name: 43rd USAEE North American Conference
organizer: United States Association for Energy Economics (USAEE)
venue: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel & Suites Pittsburgh Downtown
deadline_note: Concurrent session submissions are now closed.
submission_requirements: Full sessions (min. three, ideally four presentations) or individual works; individual works may be a full paper (with cover page and abstract) or an abstract only; author names and affiliations required. At least one author of an accepted presentation must pay the registration fee and attend in person
